label: Plato, Phaedo 100b–c: Literal self-predicative reading of beautiful itself: a FORM_1 of the…
interpretation: Literal self-predicative reading of καλὸν αὐτὸ καθ’ αὑτό: beauty itself is beautiful. This is an interpretive choice, not an explicit universal self-predication principle. The sibling reads essential characterization instead.
